analyst_view.overall: Early view: two of the surprise packages meet level on 20 points. Promoted Académico de Viseu, coached by Bruno Pinheiro, have had a historic run in their first top-flight season in 37 years with keeper Ewerton and striker André Clóvis key, and draw some of the league's best crowds at the Fontelo. Arouca under Vítor Severino lost late at Famalicão before the break after wins over Alverca and Nacional; this is refreshed with team news the day before kick-off.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Both sides are in good form and attack with intent, but Viseu's goalkeeper Ewerton has been making a lot of saves, so nothing points clearly either way yet.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.0 corners. Viseu like to play out from the back rather than go wide and long, which fits a modest corner count, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.5 cards, which is high. I lean slightly lower: there is no particular rivalry here and both sides are comfortable in the table, though Arouca did have a player sent off against Alverca, so this is a mild lean only.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots with Arouca taking more. Ewerton was averaging about 4.5 saves a game early in the season, which suggests Viseu do allow shots, so the number looks reasonable.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. Nothing in the news moves this yet, so I stay with the number until team news arrives.
